about_the_game:
ArvusForge is a 3D roguelike action game centered around material collection and weapon crafting. Defeat enemies, gather resources, and forge powerful weapons to advance through each node. Strategic growth and fast-paced combat come together in this node-based crafting action experience.


----------------Objective----------------

You play as a young blacksmith on a journey to become the best in the world. Travel through diverse stages, defeat enemies, and collect materials to enhance your weapons. At the end of your run, submit your finest creation to the grand weapon showcase, where your score is determined by the weapon’s quality. With randomized materials and skill combinations each time, every playthrough offers a fresh challenge and new possibilities for crafting.


----------------Action----------------

This is a top-down action game that doesn’t require camera control. With only attack and dodge commands, the gameplay is simple and easy to pick up. Combat features a three-stage attack system, where consecutive strikes evolve your moves. A variety of enemy types and attack patterns add depth to the fast-paced battles.


----------------Crafting System----------------

Items come with attributes such as color, skills, and grid sizes up to 3×3. Place them into a central 5×5 crafting grid to forge your weapon. The grid is divided into three sections—First, Second, and Third—each corresponding to a stage of your attack combo. By combining different skills across these stages, you can create weapons tailored to your playstyle.


Each weapon also receives a random passive effect based on its color, making every crafting result unique. Experimentation and discovery are key to mastering the forge.


----------------Additional Features----------------

・Estimated playtime: 15–30 minutes per run, with replayability focused on refining your weapon builds ・Roguelike elements: Randomized materials and skills ensure a different challenge every time ・Genre: Crafting Action / Roguelike / Progression-Based Combat

Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit processor and operating system are required.
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3570K or AMD FX-8310
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit processor and operating system are required.
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790 or AMD Ryzen 3 3200G
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX1050 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 16 MB available space
